name: sofa
description: Agentic PR reviews at your comfort: a VS Code style diff view for GitHub pull requests.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: node build.mjs && cd dist && zip -qr ../sofa-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.map' 'harness.js' && echo 'wrote sofa-'$npm_package_version'.zip'
